# PCS Truck Sales

PCS Truck Sales buys and sells commercial work trucks, bucket trucks, utility trucks, service trucks, crane trucks, flatbed trucks, dump trucks, and related commercial equipment. The business is operated by Tyler Palmer in the Rockford, Illinois area.

## Contact
- Phone: (815) 713-6291
- Email: pcstrucksales@gmail.com
- Facebook: PCS Truck Sales

## Inventory focus
- Bucket trucks
- Utility trucks
- Service trucks
- Crane trucks
- Flatbed trucks
- Dump trucks
- Commercial work trucks and related equipment

## How to buy
Call or email Tyler to confirm current availability, condition, mileage, year, make, model, engine, drivetrain, boom or crane specifications, body, controls, hydraulics, title status, included equipment, price, inspection, payment, and pickup details for the exact truck before purchase.

## How to sell
Send the year, make, model, mileage, VIN, title status, location, asking price, equipment details, known issues, and current photos for review.

## Important
PCS Truck Sales is not a repair shop and does not offer financing, delivery, inspections, or warranties unless confirmed for a specific truck. Availability and terms must be verified directly with Tyler.
